1.1.text:
Article 3

The objectives of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence are to:

Prevent acts of violence against women and children including trafficking in persons; Eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; Protect, provide a sense of security for women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; Provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; Facilitate and mediate cases of domestic violence to realize the integrity of a harmonious and prosperous household; and

Empowerment.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.

Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.

Regional People's Representative Council, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.

Discrimination is any differentiation, harassment and exclusion that is direct or indirect based on the differentiation of humans on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individual and collective in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields and other aspects of life.

Violence is any act that results in or causes suffering and pain whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or pain to women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic realm or public in private life.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or pain physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the child.

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering or pain physically, sexually, psychologically and or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in people being exploited.

Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance. Institution is an agency/instance/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Society is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

Article 7

The obligations and responsibilities of the Local Government as referred to in Article 6 letter a, include: establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children from acts of violence; conducting cooperation in the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence; providing support for facilities and infrastructure for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence; and allocating budget for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with regional financial capacity. ; The duties of the Local Government in the protection of women and children from acts of violence in the form of: Implementing policies for the protection of women and children from acts of violence established by the government; Collecting data and information about women and children in the context of efforts to protect them from acts of violence; Conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and

Conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence.

Article 8

The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, are carried out in the form of community participation.

The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children; providing protection to women and children from acts of violence, in the form of making rules and regulations in their respective areas starting from the Neighborhood Association level; providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; participating in handling victims of acts of violence; and assisting victims to the service unit.

The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out responsibly in accordance with laws and regulations.

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Local Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness raising as referred to in paragraph (1), the Local Government carries out efforts as follows: increasing the number and quality of education, both formal, non-formal, and informal; opening job opportunities for women; building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, higher education institutions and various non-governmental organizations that operate and/or care about women and children.

Article 11

The prevention of acts of violence against women and children as referred to in Article 10, is implemented by Regional Work Units whose duties and functions are in the fields of: social affairs; health; education; manpower; women's empowerment and child protection; mental and spiritual matters; and peace and order.

The prevention of acts of violence by Regional Work Units as referred to in paragraph (1), is implemented in an integrated and continuous manner.

Article 13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Local Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center in the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Affairs Office, Manpower Office, Office of Women's Empowerment and Family Planning, Non-Governmental Organizations.

P2TP2A as referred to, Social Community Organizations, Higher Education Institutions in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the service unit network and competent parties in carrying out efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 9

The obligations of the family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letters c and d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 18

The Local Government may provide financing assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.

The financing assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity, and is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

Article 19

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, orders the promulgation of this Regional Regulation by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Tambrauw Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE Article 1

Sufficiently clear.

Article 6

Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence are the joint responsibility of: regional government;. society; family; and parents.

Article 12

Forms of service provided to women and children victims of acts of violence, are as follows: complaint service;

Medical service; and medico-legal service for the purposes of evidence in the field of law.

Legal aid service: independence or empowerment service; and social rehabilitation service.

Forms of service as referred to in paragraph (1), are implemented by related Regional Work Units in accordance with the programs, activities, and budgets available in each in the fields of: social affairs; health; women's empowerment and child protection; mental and spiritual matters; manpower; and education.

Article 15

In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of work for children, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children will be established by Regent's Decree.

Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1) are regulated by Regent's Regulation.

Article 16

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency must report the implementation of the administration of prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence to the Regent.

The reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

Administration;

Finance;

Service; and

Performance.

The submission of written reports as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out at least once every 3 (three) months.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 2

Letter a

Sufficiently Clear

Letter b What is meant by "respect for the rights of victims" is a series of actions to respect, appreciate and guarantee the fulfillment of the rights of victims.

Letter c What is meant by "justice and gender equality" is a process to be fair to men and women and equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings, so as to be able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural, national defense and security activities and equality in enjoying the results of such development.

Letter d

Sufficiently Clear

Letter e

What is meant by "non-discrimination" is an attitude and treatment towards victims by not making distinctions based on age, gender, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.

Letter f

What is meant by "best interests of victims" is all the best actions concerning victims carried out by the Regional Government, community, legislative body and judicial body, so that the best interests of victims must be the primary consideration.

Article 17

Financing for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence is sourced from:

Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD) of Tambrauw Regency, and

Other legitimate sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE Article 1

Sufficiently clear.

Article 3

The objectives of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence are to:

Prevent acts of violence against women and children including trafficking in persons; Eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; Protect, provide a sense of security for women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; Provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; Facilitate and mediate cases of domestic violence to realize the integrity of a harmonious and prosperous household; and

Empowerment.

Article 9

The obligations of the family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letters c and d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 11

The prevention of acts of violence against women and children as referred to in Article 10, is implemented by Regional Work Units whose duties and functions are in the fields of: social affairs; health; education; manpower; women's empowerment and child protection; mental and spiritual matters; and peace and order.

The prevention of acts of violence by Regional Work Units as referred to in paragraph (1), is implemented in an integrated and continuous manner.

Article 8

The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, are carried out in the form of community participation.

The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children; providing protection to women and children from acts of violence, in the form of making rules and regulations in their respective areas starting from the Neighborhood Association level; providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; participating in handling victims of acts of violence; and assisting victims to the service unit.

The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out responsibly in accordance with laws and regulations.

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Local Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness raising as referred to in paragraph (1), the Local Government carries out efforts as follows: increasing the number and quality of education, both formal, non-formal, and informal; opening job opportunities for women; building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, higher education institutions and various non-governmental organizations that operate and/or care about women and children.

Article 6

Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence are the joint responsibility of: regional government;. society; family; and parents.

Article 13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Local Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center in the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Affairs Office, Manpower Office, Office of Women's Empowerment and Family Planning, Non-Governmental Organizations.

P2TP2A as referred to, Social Community Organizations, Higher Education Institutions in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the service unit network and competent parties in carrying out efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 15

In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of work for children, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children will be established by Regent's Decree.

Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1) are regulated by Regent's Regulation.

CHAPTER IV

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1.4.text:
Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.

Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.

Regional People's Representative Council, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.

Discrimination is any differentiation, harassment and exclusion that is direct or indirect based on the differentiation of humans on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individual and collective in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields and other aspects of life.

Violence is any act that results in or causes suffering and pain whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or pain to women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic realm or public in private life.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or pain physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the child.

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering or pain physically, sexually, psychologically and or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in people being exploited.

Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance. Institution is an agency/instance/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Society is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

Empowerment.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or pain physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the child.

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering or pain physically, sexually, psychologically and or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in people being exploited.

Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance. Institution is an agency/instance/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Society is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

Article 3

The objectives of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence are to:

Prevent acts of violence against women and children including trafficking in persons; Eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; Protect, provide a sense of security for women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; Provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; Facilitate and mediate cases of domestic violence to realize the integrity of a harmonious and prosperous household; and

Empowerment.

Article 19

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, orders the promulgation of this Regional Regulation by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Tambrauw Regency.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE Article 1

Sufficiently clear.

CHAPTER II

PRINCIPLES AND OBJECTIVES

Article 3

The objectives of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence are to:

Prevent acts of violence against women and children including trafficking in persons; Eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; Protect, provide a sense of security for women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; Provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; Facilitate and mediate cases of domestic violence to realize the integrity of a harmonious and prosperous household; and

Empowerment.

Article 12

Forms of service provided to women and children victims of acts of violence, are as follows: complaint service;

Medical service; and medico-legal service for the purposes of evidence in the field of law.

Legal aid service: independence or empowerment service; and social rehabilitation service.

Forms of service as referred to in paragraph (1), are implemented by related Regional Work Units in accordance with the programs, activities, and budgets available in each in the fields of: social affairs; health; women's empowerment and child protection; mental and spiritual matters; manpower; and education.

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Local Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness raising as referred to in paragraph (1), the Local Government carries out efforts as follows: increasing the number and quality of education, both formal, non-formal, and informal; opening job opportunities for women; building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, higher education institutions and various non-governmental organizations that operate and/or care about women and children.

Article 18

The Local Government may provide financing assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.

The financing assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity, and is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

CHAPTERVI

SERVICES FOR VICTIMS OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 7

The obligations and responsibilities of the Local Government as referred to in Article 6 letter a, include: establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children from acts of violence; conducting cooperation in the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence; providing support for facilities and infrastructure for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence; and allocating budget for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with regional financial capacity. ; The duties of the Local Government in the protection of women and children from acts of violence in the form of: Implementing policies for the protection of women and children from acts of violence established by the government; Collecting data and information about women and children in the context of efforts to protect them from acts of violence; Conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and

Conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence.

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Regional Government is the Regional Head as an element of Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.

Regent is the Regent of Tambrauw.

Regional People's Representative Council, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is a regional people's representative institution that is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.

Discrimination is any differentiation, harassment and exclusion that is direct or indirect based on the differentiation of humans on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individual and collective in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields and other aspects of life.

Violence is any act that results in or causes suffering and pain whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or pain to women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic realm or public in private life.

Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or pain physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the child.

Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in suffering or pain physically, sexually, psychologically and or domestic neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully within the scope of the household.

Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in people being exploited.

Child is a person who is not yet 18 years old including a child in the womb.

Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance. Institution is an agency/instance/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Society is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

Article 19

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.

In order that everyone may know of it, orders the promulgation of this Regional Regulation by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Tambrauw Regency.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

Region is Tambrauw Regency.

Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and or causes death.

Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence.

Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.

Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance. Institution is an agency/instance/body/within the scope of regional government and/or Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) that provides assistance.

Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Society is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service forum established by the Regional Government in the context of protection services for victims of violence against women and children in Tambrauw Regency.

Article 8

The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, are carried out in the form of community participation.

The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children; providing protection to women and children from acts of violence, in the form of making rules and regulations in their respective areas starting from the Neighborhood Association level; providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; participating in handling victims of acts of violence; and assisting victims to the service unit.

The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out responsibly in accordance with laws and regulations.

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Local Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness raising as referred to in paragraph (1), the Local Government carries out efforts as follows: increasing the number and quality of education, both formal, non-formal, and informal; opening job opportunities for women; building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, higher education institutions and various non-governmental organizations that operate and/or care about women and children.

Article 13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Local Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center in the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to, Social Community Organizations, Higher Education Institutions in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the service unit network and competent parties in carrying out efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 11

The prevention of acts of violence against women and children as referred to in Article 10, is implemented by Regional Work Units whose duties and functions are in the fields of: social affairs; health; education; manpower; women's empowerment and child protection; mental and spiritual matters; and peace and order.

Empowerment.

Obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence are the joint responsibility of: regional government;. society; family; and parents.

Performance.

The obligations of the family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letters c and d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

Conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence.

Prevent acts of violence against women and children including trafficking in persons; Eliminate all forms of violence and exploitation against women and children; Protect, provide a sense of security for women and children victims of violence, reporters, and witnesses; Provide services to women and children victims of acts of violence; Facilitate and mediate cases of domestic violence to realize the integrity of a harmonious and prosperous household; and

Empowerment.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.

II. ARTICLE BY ARTICLE Article 1

Sufficiently clear.

Article 10

To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Local Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness raising to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and/or counseling.

In addition to empowerment and awareness raising as referred to in paragraph (1), the Local Government carries out efforts as follows: increasing the number and quality of education, both formal, non-formal, and informal; opening job opportunities for women; building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, higher education institutions and various non-governmental organizations that operate and/or care about women and children.

Article 7

The obligations and responsibilities of the Local Government as referred to in Article 6 letter a, include: establishing policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children from acts of violence; conducting cooperation in the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence; providing support for facilities and infrastructure for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence; and allocating budget for the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with regional financial capacity. ; The duties of the Local Government in the protection of women and children from acts of violence in the form of: Implementing policies for the protection of women and children from acts of violence established by the government; Collecting data and information about women and children in the context of efforts to protect them from acts of violence; Conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and

Conducting monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence.

Article 13

In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Local Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center in the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1) above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Affairs Office, Manpower Office, Office of Women's Empowerment and Family Planning, Non-Governmental Organizations.

P2TP2A as referred to, Social Community Organizations, Higher Education Institutions in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's Decree.

P2TP2A of Tambrauw Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the service unit network and competent parties in carrying out efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 18

The Local Government may provide financing assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement the protection of women and children from acts of violence and discrimination.

The financing assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity, and is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

Article 14

For the implementation of services for victims of human trafficking, the Regent of Tambrauw establishes a task force for the criminal act of human trafficking.

The task force for the criminal act of human trafficking as referred to in paragraph (1) is a coordinating body tasked with coordinating the prevention and handling of human trafficking.

Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force for the criminal act of human trafficking as referred to in paragraph (1) are established by Regent's Decree.

Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Integrated Service Center, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.

Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Society is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations. I. GENERAL

The State has the obligation to provide Protection to every citizen in accordance with the preamble of the Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia of 1945. That Women and Children are among vulnerable groups that tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Such Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination.

Violence is any unlawful act with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against Women is any action based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or misery of Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against Children is any act against Children that results in suffering or misery physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of Children. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not received adequate services and therefore minimum services are required for Victims of Violence.

In order to prevent and overcome Violence against Women and Children in Badung Regency so as to avoid Violence, threats of Violence, torture or treatment that degrades the degree and dignity of humanity, it is necessary to provide Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates the efforts of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Badung Regency.
